info.title: Remote Jobs API: 6 Boards, Worldwide or Country-Eligible
info.description:
Remote jobs from six boards in one call, deduplicated, each tagged worldwide, region-locked or hybrid with the employer's own sentence as proof.

Sold on API.market: https://api.market/store/benthepythondev/remote-jobs-six-boards (plans, free trial and API key). Call it through the API.market gateway with your API.market key in the x-api-market-key header.

post.description: Search six remote job boards (Arbeitnow, Jobicy, Himalayas, RemoteOK, Remotive, Working Nomads) in one call and get one deduplicated list. A job posted on several boards comes back once, with every source link in a sources field. Pass eligibleFrom with your countries or regions and it reads the employer's own text to drop jobs you cannot take; each row says remote_scope, eligible_locations, the evidence sentence and work_arrangement. Rows also carry a visa_sponsorship flag with the employer's sentence (filter with visaSponsorshipOnly) and salary_usd_yearly_min/max. Up to 20 jobs per request, as JSON.

searchQueries.title: Searches
searchQueries.description: One or more searches, e.g. 'python developer', 'react', 'marketing'. A job is kept when it matches any of them; inside one search all terms must appear somewhere in the job record.

searchKeywords.title: Search keywords (single, older field)
searchKeywords.description: One search, e.g. 'python developer'. Kept so saved inputs keep working; it is searched together with Searches.

platforms.title: Job boards
platforms.description: Choose the keyless sources to combine.

maxJobsPerPlatform.title: Maximum jobs per board
maxJobsPerPlatform.description: Maximum records collected from each selected source before cross-board deduplication. A request returns 20 rows at most.

excludeKeywords.title: Exclude keywords
excludeKeywords.description: Drop jobs containing any of these terms in the title, company, location, description, or tags.

companyKeywords.title: Company keywords
companyKeywords.description: Keep jobs whose company contains at least one supplied term.

locationKeywords.title: Location keywords
locationKeywords.description: Keep jobs whose location contains at least one term, such as Europe, Germany, or Worldwide.

eligibleFrom.title: Where you can work from
eligibleFrom.description: Keep jobs you can apply to from these countries or regions, read from the employer's own text ("must be based in", "authorized to work in", "CET +/- 3 hours"). Worldwide jobs always pass. Examples: Germany, India, Brazil, Europe, EMEA, LATAM.

includeUnclearEligibility.title: Keep jobs with unclear eligibility
includeUnclearEligibility.description: With 'Where you can work from' set, also keep jobs whose listing names no country, region or worldwide hiring. Off by default.

excludeHybrid.title: Exclude hybrid jobs
excludeHybrid.description: Drop jobs whose text asks for office days ("hybrid work model", "3 days a week in the office").

visaSponsorshipOnly.title: Only jobs that offer visa sponsorship
visaSponsorshipOnly.description: Keep only jobs whose text says the employer sponsors a visa ("visa sponsorship available", "we will sponsor"). Jobs that say nothing are dropped.

jobTypes.title: Job types
jobTypes.description: Keep selected normalized employment types. Jobs without a matching type are excluded when this filter is active.

seniorityLevels.title: Seniority levels
seniorityLevels.description: Keep inferred levels based on title and tags. Unspecified roles are excluded when this filter is active.

salaryOnly.title: Salary present only
salaryOnly.description: Return only jobs where the source provides salary data.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within days
postedWithinDays.description: Keep jobs posted within this many days. Use 0 to disable. Records without a parseable date are excluded when enabled.

201.description: The results, one object per row.
